ef25851c60118286690f07070ba5748bf4a6e22d.reason: 0.4.4 over source set cef27234 (r13i/r13j): the Intel branch's r13d and r13e merged (from the same r13c). Eden gains four flags in mma_layout.h, all off on NVIDIA (vk_coopmat.cpp coopmat_init): the compare-exchange cap, invariant positions and the colour NaN guard for cards other than NVIDIA, and storage buffer ends from the unrounded address on alignments over 16. Off, every emitter path is the one before (the branch measured it on an RTX 5070 Ti: 0 SPIR-V modules different out of 90272). On, vk_shader.cpp disk_stamp adds them, so those cards keep their programs apart. vk_shader.cpp, vk_draw.cpp, vk_memory.cpp and vk_internal.h carry the branch's uniform snapshot on Intel. r13i over source set ddcef176 (r13f-r13h): Eden inlines the global-load helper in the task and mesh stages (Hookshot PR 1334, the floating trees; EDEN_NX2_GM_INLINE=0: not, an EDEN_ switch and so in the stamp). Compute, vertex and fragment programs translate as before. The task and mesh programs do not, and the stamp is kept for the rest only: vk_shader.cpp writes their records with kind 16 and leaves a task or mesh record without it out of the index (stale_mesh_record), so they are translated again, once; the prepared marker (program_prepared_stamp) differs from r13h's, so that happens in the first start's preparation. vk_shader.cpp/.h also carry those. r13f over source set a40b759f (r13d/r13e): Eden takes mesh output topology 0 (points, Hookshot v2.1.0 8ef84611): translate_program.cpp no longer refuses it, and emit_spirv.cpp, spirv_emit_context.cpp/.h and emit_spirv_mesh.cpp choose the output mode, the index builtin, the map size and the index count by MeshInfo::Corners(), which is 2 for topology 1 and 3 for 4, as the expressions they replace; a point program that writes no PointSize gets 1.0. Kept by construction, not measured module by module: every program of topology 1 or 4 translates as before, and a topology 0 program was refused, so none is in a cache (program_cache_save runs on success only). r13d over source set b81c50bf (r13c): vk_shader.cpp only appends device_file_tag() (vk_main.cpp: empty for the device Auto chooses) to the kept-program file names in program_cache_file, so a GPU picked by the panel's GPU device row keeps files of its own instead of emptying the other's; no translation code changed. r13c over source set 1e9a0ec5 (r13b): vk_shader.cpp/.h only name the kept-program files by mesh shader path (program_cache_file: the native names unchanged, _compute and _mixed for the fallback paths) and index the fallback records (one kind encoding, record_kind); no translation code changed. r13b: r13 mesh shader compute fallback (Hookshot v2.1.0 issue 640) over source set aa316a19 (the controls candidate, whose reason follows). Every Eden/Sirit/vk_shader change runs only with RuntimeInfo::mesh_fallback or mesh_fallback_vertex, or for a Program with fallback set; the program cache's records keep their layout unless fallback, and a GPU on the fallback path gets a file of its own (disk_stamp adds the mesh mode). Checked on an RTX 5070 Ti: the 46638 programs of the shader seed translated by this source set against the r13 cache made by aa316a19, 90278 (key, stage) module sets, 0 SPIR-V modules different (task 1167, mesh 1295, compute 4087, vertex 41206, fragment 42381; 142 keys had a variant the new cache had not made yet). Controls candidate 2026-11-10: vk_api.h appends physical-binding enums and four host callbacks, API 1 to 2. Eden/Sirit/compat, shader translation, vk_shader.h, vk_state.h and serialized program info are byte-identical to checkpoint v7. Differential write-back uses an independent built-in SPIR-V; it does not alter guest shader translation.
